item.title: Other laws: Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 2026 in force: cloud and electronic bank records
item.description:
Other laws · Act · Act 15 of 2026

Effective 2026-10-01.

Who it covers: Banks, and other financial sector entities to which the Central Government extends the Act, producing account statements in court or tribunal.

  • The 1891 Act is repealed.
  • Bankers' books expressly include electronic, offsite, cloud and disaster-recovery records.
  • Certified copies can be signed digitally by the branch head, office head or an authorised officer, in the forms in the Schedules.

Official source

item.title: Other laws: PSS Act s. 10A: no-charge rule now covers modes notified by the Central Government
item.description:
Other laws · Act · Act 21 of 2026, s. 2

Effective 2026-08-17.

Who it covers: Banks and payment system providers.

  • The electronic payment modes on which no charge may be levied are now those notified by the Central Government, no longer those prescribed under s. 269SU of the Income-tax Act, 1961.

Official source

item.title: Other laws: Tribunals Reforms Act, 2026: DRT, DRAT and consumer commission appointments
item.description:
Other laws · Act · Act 17 of 2026

Effective 2026-08-25.

Who it covers: Debts Recovery Tribunals, Appellate Tribunals and consumer commissions.

  • RDB Act ss. 6A and 15A are substituted: service conditions of DRT Presiding Officers and the DRAT Chairperson follow the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2026.
  • Consumer Protection Act s. 55(1A) is substituted to the same effect.

Official source

item.title: Other laws: Tamil Nadu extends registration deadline to 270 days
item.description:
Other laws · Order · G.O. Ms. No. 254, Home

Effective 2026-08-04.

Who it covers: Money lending entities operating in Tamil Nadu on 19-11-2025.

  • Removal of Difficulties Order, 2026 substitutes 'two hundred and seventy days' for 'ninety days' in the proviso to s. 5(1), because the online portal was notified only on 27-02-2026.

Official source

item.title: Other laws: Tamil Nadu: District Collectors named Registering Authorities for money lending entities
item.description:
Other laws · Notification · G.O. Ms. No. 85, Home

Effective 2026-02-16.

Who it covers: Money lending entities that must register under the Tamil Nadu Act.

  • District Collectors are the Registering Authorities for their districts under s. 4(1).

Official source

item.title: Other laws: Notices by post: 'registered post' becomes 'speed post with registration'
item.description:
Other laws · Act · Act 37 of 2025

Effective 2025-12-20.

Who it covers: Anyone serving notices by post under central laws, including SARFAESI and cheque-bounce demand notices.

  • General Clauses Act s. 27 now deems service by post effected when a notice is sent by speed post with registration.
  • Matching changes are made to the Code of Civil Procedure.
  • Spent amending Acts, including Arbitration, NI and Factoring amendments, are repealed; their changes stay in the principal Acts.

Official source

item.title: Other laws: Tamil Nadu coercive-recovery law comes into force
item.description:
Other laws · State Act · G.O.(Ms) No. 580, Home

Effective 2025-11-19.

Who it covers: Money lending entities in Tamil Nadu. RBI-registered NBFCs, co-operative banks and co-operative societies are covered by the ban on coercive action only; banks are outside the Act.

  • Tamil Nadu Act 40 of 2025 is in force from 19-11-2025.
  • Unregistered lenders may not lend or recover; the Act sets pricing, disclosure and loan-card rules.
  • Coercive recovery against borrowers and their families is an offence with up to five years' imprisonment.

Official source
